questions.q: Who was the prince looking for?
o: The most beautiful girl in the kingdom
questions.e: The prince wanted to marry, but the princess had to be a real one.

questions.q: What was the weather like the evening the princess appeared at the gate?
questions.e: “Grmelo je i sevalo, i kiša je strašno pljuštala” — it thundered, lightning flashed, and the rain poured.

questions.q: What did the queen put at the bottom of the bed?
questions.e: “Stavila je zrno graška na dno” — she put a pea at the bottom.

questions.q: How many mattresses did the queen pile on top of the pea?
questions.e: “Zatim je prekrila zrno sa dvadeset dušeka” — then she covered the pea with twenty mattresses.

questions.q: What did the princess say in the morning when asked how she slept?
o: That she slept badly: she lay on something hard and was black and blue
questions.e: “Ležala sam na nečemu tvrdom, sva sam modra” — I lay on something hard, I'm black and blue.

questions.q: Why did everyone decide she was a real princess?
o: She named her father the king
She felt the pea through twenty mattresses
She arrived wearing a royal crown
questions.e: “Mogla je da oseti zrno graška kroz dvadeset dušeka” — she could feel the pea through twenty mattresses.
